oneTimers: Inside the small $761M G&A line is a favorable $1.55B adjustment: Meta reduced what it had previously set aside for certain legal cases. Without it, operating income would have been about $21.8B instead of $23.4B.
otherDetail: Interest and other income of $188M, net.

segments.name: Advertising
segments.note: Ads across Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp — ad impressions rose 6% and the average price per ad rose 14%.

segments.name: Family of Apps other revenue
segments.note: Mostly WhatsApp business messaging and other fees from the social apps.

segments.name: Reality Labs
segments.note: Quest headsets and Ray-Ban Meta glasses — $1.1B of revenue against a $5.0B operating loss.

takeaways.text: Advertising revenue grew 21% to $46.8B — 97 cents of every dollar Meta made — helped by 6% more ad views and a 14% higher average price per ad.
takeaways.title: Ads did the lifting

takeaways.text: Meta cut what it had set aside for certain legal cases by $1.55B, a one-off boost that sits inside G&A and flatters this quarter's profit; the underlying business was still strongly profitable.
takeaways.title: A legal adjustment flattered profit

takeaways.text: Reality Labs lost $5.0B in the quarter on $1.1B of revenue — the metaverse and headset bet is still funded entirely by the ad business.
takeaways.title: Reality Labs still burns cash

verdict: Meta's revenue jumped 21% to $48.4B as advertising grew 21% — and a $1.55B favorable legal adjustment made the quarter look even better, lifting profit to $20.8B, about 43 cents of every dollar.
